source: Final list of Ahmedabad Durga Puja 2026, 16–21 October (community poster, assets/reference/pandal_list_final.jpg). It replaced the earlier list, assets/reference/pandal_list.jpg, on 2026-10-13.
about: Names and addresses are transcribed from the final list, which the owner supplied as verified. Spelling corrections, and the one entry the list prints twice, are explained in each record's "transcriptionNotes". Every pandal is pinned from an OpenStreetMap address lookup (see each record's "verification"); most pins mark the area, not the venue. "descriptionBasis" says whether a description draws on the published sources listed in "descriptionSources" or only on the list and general Durga Puja traditions. "schedule" holds hours from the list or organisers; pandals without real hours get a tentative "planningCutoff" instead, which is a planning aid, never a closing time.

pandals.description: Gitanjali Durgotsav, organised by the Gitanjali Seva Trust, is held at Poojan Farm on Manthan Road in Vatva, south-east Ahmedabad, near Mahalaxmi Char Rasta and Osia Mall. Farm and party plot venues are a familiar home for pujos in the city, and the five days follow the rhythm loved in Bengal: the Goddess welcomed on Shashthi, anjali on Ashtami morning and a tearful farewell on Bijoya Dashami. Osia Mall is the easiest landmark to look for.

pandals.description: This is the Durga Puja of the Bengal Cultural Association, widely described as Ahmedabad’s oldest Bengali organisation, whose pujo goes back more than eight decades; it marked its 86th puja in 2023. In past years it was held beside the Kalibari temple in Ambli, with dhunuchi dance, community bhog, Bengali food, drama and cultural performances drawing tens of thousands of visitors. For 2026 the list gives Ahmedabad Kalibari, Sindhu Bhavan Road, near the Taj hotel; this year’s programme has not been announced.

The festival’s traditional moments remain the same wherever it is held: the Goddess’s welcome on Shashthi, anjali on Ashtami and the farewell of Bijoya Dashami.
